teaser: Ten at night and the last light in the house is still yours, phone in hand, already rearranging tomorrow into something looser. Life path 5 carries a hunger for motion; ESFP carries a hunger for the moment itself. Crossed, they do not pull in opposite directions so much as the same direction, twice as hard. What is particular to this crossing is how little resistance there is to either hunger: nothing in you argues back, no quiet voice saying wait, which makes the open road both the comfort and the catch.
